transformer.name: protobuf-binary
transformer.title: Protobuf Binary
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to binary (byte array) using Jackson Protobuf (supports Protobuf schema)

transformerIn.description: Needs the Protobuf schema in the X-Content-Schema exchange property: a Json object or array as text, Protobuf binary, a JsonNode or a POJO; a Map or a null body fail. Bytes or a stream with the Content-Type application/protobuf or protobuf/binary are Protobuf binary already, and are kept as they are, without the schema

transformerOut.description: Protobuf binary as bytes; a body that is Protobuf binary already is kept, also a stream, with its Content-Type
